mentions.name: rightmind
mentions.description: Multi-agent setup that tackles complex problems by leveraging the diversity of multiple LLMs. Its "all angles" mode runs multiple strategies in parallel, then a judge agent presents a summary including a view on how the strategies agreed and diverged from one another.
mentions.source_excerpt: Multi Agent setup to tackle complex problems using the diversity of multiple LLMs. All for personal use but finding it very useful especially what I call the 'all angles' where it runs multiple strategies parallel then a judge agent presents summary including a view on how the strategies agreed and diverge from one another.
